item.text: The component currently passes `start` and `cancel` straight through, so it has no initiation guard or synchronous disabled feedback. Its device selection delegates to the shared hook, and I’m checking how that hook/menu represent devices so the fix follows their existing contract.

The implementation now uses a ref as the handler-level lock (so duplicate activations are blocked before React rerenders) and renders the disabled state immediately. Device selection closes the menu and only passes a real selected `MediaDeviceInfo` to the hook. The targeted existing test is running now.
